title: Double Bundle Reconstruction

positions.as_written: Expect the cadaveric difference to be largest near extension.
Treat this as a decision about marginal mechanical gain against definite added complexity, in an operation whose results are already less reliable than its anterior counterpart.
Prefer two bundles where the capsule and corner are deficient and graft allows.
Recognise the constraint as a resource one rather than a mechanical one.
Plan tunnel trajectories and bone bridge before committing to two bundles.
Consider staging where graft and time are both short.
